evidence.dominant_driver: September Australian activity slowed sharply while price pressure firmed: composite 50.8 vs 52.7 prior, services 51.4 vs 53.2, manufacturing 49.3 vs 52.0, manufacturing output 46.4 vs 49.6; input inflation rose to a three-month high and job losses appeared for the first time since May.

market_expectations.expected_value: Consensus references around 52.0 composite, 51.7 manufacturing and 52.5 services; all four major banks expected a 25bp RBA hike to 4.60% on Sep 29.
market_expectations.distribution_notes: Activity missed expectations, but stronger price pressure prevents a clean dovish interpretation.

absorption.reason: Release is about 48 minutes old; AUD/USD around 0.7109 was soft and short-term technicals were sell-biased, but a clean AUS200 reaction was not available.

observations.RBA_channel: price pressures argue against a strongly dovish rates reaction
observations.global_oil: lower, supportive for inflation but stale
